title: 2027 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Goat
seo_title: 2027 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Goat (6 February – 25 January 2028)
description: 2027 is the Year of the Fire Goat (Yin, Ding-wei), from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2027.
lead: Born in 2027? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Goat, but check the date: the 2027 Fire Goat year begins on 6 February 2027. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2027: Year of the Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028.

image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2027 will be the Year of the Goat. It begins with Lunar New Year on 6 February 2027 and ends on 25 January 2028, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2027 ends in 7, which makes it a Fire year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2027 is a Ding-wei year. The same Fire Goat combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1967 before it and 2087 after it.
Lunar New Year 2027 falls on 6 February 2027, so everyone born in January 2027, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Horse.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Goat guide describes the sign like this: “Gentle, creative, and compassionate. Goats have a strong artistic sensibility and care deeply for others.” The usual watch-out: “Can be indecisive or overly dependent on others.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Goat page.
Careers often linked with the Goat: art, design, counseling, nonprofit work.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2027
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Goat's best matches are the Rabbit, Horse and Pig, and its clash sign is the Ox, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Goat, it is listed as a supportive match of the Horse, so 2026 is traditionally a friendly year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Goat, 2027 is a Goat year, so Goat people are in their own year (ben ming nian). See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Goat years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 2003 (Water Goat); 2015 (Wood Goat); 2039 (Earth Goat). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2027 is the Year of the Goat, a Yin Fire Goat year (Ding-wei).
When does the 2027 Year of the Goat start and end?
It starts on 6 February 2027 and ends on 25 January 2028.
I was born in January 2027. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Horse: Lunar New Year 2027 is on 6 February 2027, so all of January 2027 belongs to the Horse year.
Fire. 2027 ends in 7, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Goat compatible with?
Traditionally the Rabbit, Horse and Pig. The Goat's clash sign is the Ox.
